meta.scope: Myanmar Batch 1 — Phase 0/1 foundations under locked expanded node definition. Central Statistical Organization (CSO), population, national accounts, CPI, Central Bank of Myanmar institutional core, BOP. Population ~55 million. Data environment constrained by political and institutional conditions.

candidates.title: Central Statistical Organization (CSO) institutional core
candidates.description: Primary national statistical office responsible for censuses, surveys, national accounts, prices, labour, demographic and multi-domain socio-economic statistics. Publishes the Statistical Yearbook and participates in the IMF enhanced General Data Dissemination System (e-GDDS).
candidates.notes: Foundational institutional node for the Myanmar statistical system. Data continuity and coverage are constrained relative to many peers.

candidates.title: Population census and estimates
candidates.description: Official population census and subsequent estimates. Population is approximately 55 million; the age structure remains relatively young.

candidates.title: National Accounts of Myanmar (GDP)
candidates.description: Official national accounts (GDP). Central macro-output series for an economy heavily shaped by agriculture, extractives, informal activity and political-institutional constraints.
candidates.notes: Primary macroeconomic output node. Interpretation requires care given data gaps and informal activity.

candidates.title: Consumer Price Index and inflation statistics
candidates.description: CPI and inflation rates. Inflation has been elevated and volatile in recent years under exchange-rate pressures and supply disruptions.
candidates.notes: Core high-frequency price node under elevated-inflation conditions.

candidates.title: Central Bank of Myanmar institutional and reporting core
candidates.description: Central bank responsible for monetary policy, foreign-exchange management and key macro-financial and external statistics. Publishes monetary, banking, exchange-rate, BOP and related series where available.

candidates.title: Balance of Payments and external accounts
candidates.description: BOP and external-sector statistics. Current-account dynamics, limited FDI, and large errors and omissions reflecting informal and unrecorded cross-border activity are recurring features.
candidates.notes: External-accounts node under constrained data and institutional conditions.

candidates.title: Myanmar foundational statistical-system meta-node
candidates.publisher: Derived from CSO and CBM sources
candidates.description: Meta-node binding the CSO institutional core, population, national accounts, CPI, CBM institutional role and BOP into the opening foundation layer for Myanmar research.
referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
candidates.notes: Opening integrating node for Myanmar research. Data quality and coverage constraints should be carried forward in subsequent batches.
